data.one_liner: A cross-platform plugin for embedding a Python runtime into Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Embeds a CPython runtime into mobile and desktop Flutter apps so you can run Python code in the background without blocking the UI. It provides a CLI tool to package your Python application, dependencies, and interpreters for native platforms or web.
use_when: You want to run heavy lifting tasks, data processing, machine learning, or AI written in Python inside a Flutter app
You need to host an application backend service in Python locally inside the mobile or desktop app
avoid_when: You need direct, synchronous Dart-to-Python function calls instead of communicating via local REST, sockets, or files
You are building a lightweight pure-Dart application without any Python codebase requirement
strengths: Cross-platform support for iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, and Windows
Runs Python programs on a background thread so the Flutter UI stays responsive
CLI tool simplifies packaging Python apps and third-party requirements
weaknesses: Requires manual CLI packaging steps and specific environment variable configurations
Communication between Dart and Python must occur via an API provided by the Python program (like REST or sockets) rather than direct function calls
Platform support requires minimum OS versions like iOS 15.0 and macOS 12.0
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum iOS deployment targets (platform :ios, '15.0'), using the CLI tool to package Python requirements, and configuring environment variables like SERIOUS_PYTHON_VERSION.
